recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted two-operation scope and avoids changing unrelated examples or operation behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-41229 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by Vocabulary and requested an optional lenient-display-validation parameter for $validate-code so wrong displays can be warnings rather than making result false. The accepted resolution explicitly applied this to both CodeSystem and ValueSet $validate-code.
initial_application: Commit 4cd9f00b61 partially applied the issue by adding lenient-display-validation to source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml, but it did not update source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-validate-code.xml.
additional_context: CodeSystem and ValueSet are active FHIR resources in source/fhir.ini, and source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-validate-code. Vocabulary WGM minutes on 2023-05-10 reference FHIR-41229 and point to the Jira resolution. Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-41229 discussion contradicting the Jira decision.
reconciliation: The published commit adds lenient-display-validation to CodeSystem/$validate-code with the same optional boolean cardinality and documentation already present on ValueSet/$validate-code.
source_changes: source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-validate-code.xml: added optional boolean input parameter lenient-display-validation after displayLanguage.
